note: Two reusable rule candidates came out of the story-029 work and its review; no fallow or complaint signal was present.

candidates.text: Avoid local `:global(body)` style overrides in Svelte page components; rely on the global stylesheet for base typography, colors, and background so every page shares the same design language.
candidates.rationale: The original lookahead page overrode `body` with Inter/blue styles. Removing that override let the sage/cream tokens apply consistently across the landing and lookahead pages.

candidates.text: Use the shared Button component for primary CTAs; extend it with an `href` prop when the action is a navigation link, rather than duplicating button styles in page CSS.
candidates.rationale: The landing page initially reimplemented primary-button styles for its CTA anchor. Adding `href` to Button let the page use the design-system primitive and removed the duplication.
